items.title: Show HN: PicoMQ – Durable Streams over HTTP, on object storage
items.summary: PicoMQ is a Rust server for Durable Streams, built on Object Store. Cheap, URL-addressable, granular streams (create/append/read/long-poll/SSE), with Pico Protocol or Durable Streams Protocol as the facade. S3Stream is the stream storage primitive, used in AutoMQ, shipped as a Rust library. Coordination is a command log in Postgres. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49421806 Points: 63 # Comments: 9
